objective: Test whether SaSPA-style edge and subject conditioning can create label-faithful, diverse TRKH mango images from immutable train data while fitting an RTX 4060 Laptop GPU with 8 GB VRAM.
hypothesis: A full-frame yolo_f train image supplies structure and context through Canny edges, while a different-source same-class class_f crop supplies fine-grained surface and ripeness information through BLIP-Diffusion subject conditioning. The combination may preserve the class-defining fruit signal while varying context more safely than direct image mixing.

No validation or test metric may be used to tune generation, prompts, filtering, thresholds, architecture, or synthetic ratio.
No current-best checkpoint, full-train command, command history, production model, raw dataset, or split may change from this A0.

tiny_cohort.edge_view: Full yolo_f train frame; Canny edges retain object layout and wide context.
tiny_cohort.subject_view: Corresponding class_f train crop from a different leakage_group but the same class.
selection_algorithm: Join manifest.csv to yolo_f train images by output_image and use leakage_group as source identity.
Parse YOLO labels and keep only the fixed eligibility cohort.
For edge candidates, sort each class by SHA256('edge|' + protocol_id + '|' + leakage_group + '|' + relative_yolo_path) and take the first two without group reuse.

For each edge candidate, sort same-class class_f candidates by SHA256('subject|' + protocol_id + '|' + edge_leakage_group + '|' + subject_leakage_group + '|' + relative_crop_path) and take the first candidate satisfying all distinctness rules.
Assign prompt template by zero-based edge rank modulo two.
Derive the per-output seed from the first unsigned 63 bits of SHA256('seed|' + protocol_id + '|' + edge_relative_path + '|' + subject_relative_path + '|' + prompt_index).
No visual cherry-picking, replacement, or regeneration is allowed after output inspection.

phase_f0_no_output.failure_behavior: Fail closed with no output generation. Do not loosen a gate after observing a failure.

phase_f1_tiny_output.prerequisite: F0 passed and the selected source manifest hash is locked.
phase_f1_tiny_output.generation_order: Ascending class index, then ascending locked edge hash rank.
phase_f1_tiny_output.fallback_behavior: If the primary offload mode fails before a saved output, restart once with sequential CPU offload. If either mode violates a locked gate after saving an output, reject A0 without retrying parameters or seeds.

train_only_reference_statistics.pair_selection: Deterministic SHA256 ranking from eligible non-selected train groups.
train_only_reference_statistics.candidate_limit: Synthetic bbox crop versus its subject crop must remain within the class-specific 95th percentile for every statistic. Thresholds are fitted from train only.
